question: What auspicious and sovereign roles define the divine figure's relation to the world?
premises: The figure possesses an auspicious form.
The figure serves as refuge and lord of the world.
The figure is the protector of people.
inference: The divine figure is both auspicious in form and sovereign protector of the world and its people.
